description.full_text: The image features a colorful wheel divided into segments, each representing different emotions. The segments are labeled with Chinese text, including emotions such as 平静 (calm), 快乐 (happiness), 信任 (trust), and 悲伤 (sadness). A smaller, similarly colored cone-like shape appears to the upper left. The mood is vibrant and informative, suggesting an exploration of emotional diversity and complexity. The bright colors create an engaging and positive atmosphere.
